script_text: Stop! Aquarius, the stars are screaming at you right now. Uranus, your air ruling planet, is forming a sharp sextile to Neptune in your 10th House, igniting career ambition. This airy aspect stirs your 7th House of partnership, asking for honest, unconventional intimacy. This sextile asks you to trust your intuition while your public reputation grows. If you are single, you may attract a magnetic rebel who challenges your independence; if partnered, watch for ego battles before real connection deepens, and keep dates playful and free for single Aquarius. Financially, your 10th House luck runs through networking tonight, so pitch that bold idea. Your 2nd House of money may also feel unstable, but a sudden expense or windfall could balance it. Avoid stubborn pride in negotiations. Unexpectedly, a small grant or bonus lands from an unexpected source. Follow for tomorrow’s reading.
